mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the skies are clear at Badger Prairie County Park, and the full moon will be visible tonight. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is preparing for a November 4th Plan Commission meeting to discuss several development projects, including 80 new lots at Ardent Glen. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, and you can view your tax information online through Access Dane.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights on October 27th and 28th, and the popular Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no students were injured during the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. The Culver's in Verona is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight.
